description: The agent must: (1) Read q3_audit_briefing.json to understand all three checkpoint requirements. (2) For CP-1: invoke `node /opt/skills/truetime/scripts/true_time.mjs --plus 2.5month --user-tz Europe/Berlin --calendar-tz Europe/Berlin` — critically, the agent MUST supply `--calendar-tz` (a proprietary flag from SKILL.md) for calendar-unit decimal arithmetic; omitting it or computing 2.5 months as a fixed number of seconds will produce wrong results. (3) For CP-2: invoke `node .../true_time.mjs --target 2026-09-15T10:00:00 --target-tz Asia/Tokyo --user-tz America/Chicago`, extracting that the UTC target is 2026-09-15T01:00:00Z and Chicago CDT shows 2026-09-14T20:00:00-05:00. (4) For CP-3: invoke with `--time-source ntp --user-tz America/Chicago --plus 45m`, ensuring `time_source=ntp` and `ntp_server` appear in the output — per SKILL.md, if the user requests non-server time, NTP must be used and any NTP failure must STOP execution rather than silently fallback. (5) Assemble all TrueTime JSON output fields (including `now_lunar`, `target_lunar`, `delta_milliseconds`, `time_source`, `ntp_server` for CP-3) into a `schedule_report.json` with a top-level `checkpoints` list.
